unlisted_practices: Hospitals should adopt threshold-based planning supported by multi-agent AI systems to complement scenario-based contingency planning for unprecedented climatic emergencies.
Hospitals should build a comprehensive database of operational thresholds for hospital components to ground agentic AI in accurate domain-specific data.
Agentic AI for hospital climate preparedness should demonstrate robust, reliable performance and alignment with ethical and governance frameworks through testing in controlled simulations and drills.

screen.reason: This is a perspective/commentary article proposing that emerging agentic AI technology can assist hospitals with emergency preparedness and climate resilience via a threshold-based framework.
